title: Config Reconciler & Evidence Ops Runner for Residency/Retention
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a continuously running reconciler that compares declared compliance configuration (policy-as-code for data residency & retention) against the runtime serving plane and storage configs, automatically generates tamper-evident evidence bundles, and either remediates safe mismatches or creates verified remediation tasks. This ticket covers design, a prototype operator (k8s + lambda hybrid), evidence artifact format, and telemetry to support audits.
background: Customers require auditable proof that residency and retention settings are enforced across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Existing checks are ad-hoc (admissions, manual audits). We need an automated background process that reconciles desired config -> actual state, records immutable evidence, and triggers remediation with human-in-the-loop for high-risk changes.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler detects divergence between policy-as-code (git repo) and runtime state for residency and retention within 2 minutes of mutation in controlled tests
For low-risk mismatches (metadata-only, e.g., label drift), reconciler can auto-correct with an audit entry and rollback-safe mechanism
For high-risk mismatches (data moved out of allowed region or retention shortened), reconciler creates a remediation ticket with signed evidence bundle and notifies on #compliance-alerts
Evidence bundle stored in S3 with versioned path + SHA256 manifest and a signed URL accessible for 90 days; metadata includes discovery timestamp, diff, affected resources, operator actions
End-to-end integration test that simulates a misplaced retention TTL shows an evidence bundle and either auto-remediate or create ticket per policy table
Unit and e2e tests in CI with >= 90% coverage on reconciliation logic
Security review completed and design doc updated with KMS/HSM usage for signing evidence
tasks: Design reconciler architecture and runbook (k8s controller vs serverless hybrid)
Define evidence bundle JSON schema and signing protocol (use KMS asymmetric keys)
Implement Git-backed policy fetcher and change-watcher (webhook + periodic poll)
Implement runtime snapshotters: serving control-plane API, storage metadata (S3/GCS meta), Dedicated GPU pool metadata
Diff engine to compute semantic changes for residency/retention fields
Remediation subsystem with safe auto-fix rules and human-in-the-loop escalation
Integrate with ticketing (Linear API) and Slack notifications (#compliance-alerts)
Create e2e tests and CI job; document rollout canary plan and telemetry dashboards
implementation_notes: Prototype will run as a k8s Deployment in Hosted control plane cluster. For Private customers where control plane cannot access infra, we will ship an agent that pushes evidence to customer S3 and the control plane only receives signed manifests. Evidence bundles will include: git commit id of policy, runtime snapshot JSON, computed diff, operator action record, and PEM signature. Use KMS-as-a-service for signing in Hosted (with key rotation), and HSM integration option for Private. Auto-fix will be gated behind two switches: policy severity table and per-customer opt-in flag.
tradeoffs_and_risks: Auto-remediation reduces mean time to compliance but risks accidental data movement; therefore high-risk operations require manual approval. Running the reconciler in control plane raises access surface area; we'll limit credentials to read-only where possible and sign evidence with a separate signing key. Private deployment agent design must avoid exfiltration risks; evidence should be stored under customer-controlled buckets when requested.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge design doc and secure approval. 2) Ship prototype in staging with webhook-driven tests. 3) Canary to 2 internal teams. 4) Add KMS signing and S3 evidence storage. 5) Enable auto-fix in opt-in mode for low-risk rules. 6) Gradual enablement for customers tied to compliance onboarding.
